subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

'Well, that was ______ good,' said Harper.
solution:
The correct answer is **"pretty."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Pretty"** is an adverb which means quite; fairly. (काफ़ी; बहुत कुछ)

 
 
• **Example**: *The film was **pretty**__ good.*
 
 
 
• The word** "pretty" **is modifying the adjective **"good."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *'Well, that was __**pretty**__ good,' said Harper.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Pleasing"** means giving you pleasure and satisfaction. (सुखकर और संतोषप्रद)
 
• **Option 2: "Gorgeous" **means extremely pleasant or attractive. (अत्‍यंत प्रीतिकर या आकर्षक, भव्‍य, शानदार)
 
• **Option 3: "Beautiful"** means very pretty or attractive; giving pleasure to the senses. (सुंदर, ख़ूबसूरत, आकर्षक; रमणीय, प्रियकर)

37:Tc54,

The correct answer is **"generous."**
